basic_profile.bio: Just a curious reader starting my journey on Reddit. I'm an aspiring bookworm based in Portland, OR, trying to balance my newfound love for book discussions with my job as a junior marketing analyst. I've always been fascinated by storytelling and narratives, whether in books or through conversation. I enjoy exploring various genres, but historical fiction and memoirs are my favorites. When I'm not working or reading, you can find me tinkering with electric car mods or exploring the local food scene. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work. Currently single and enjoying the freedom to dive into my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm relatively new to the world of online book clubs, but I've always had a passion for reading. My expertise mainly comes from personal reading experiences and a few college courses on literature. I'm also dipping my toes into the world of electric car technology, driven by a personal project to mod my own vehicle.
